messages:
anya: Quick sync — for next sprint we need to pick priorities between evidence indexing (faster search) vs retention/export SLAs for enterprise BYOK customers. AcmeBank demands legal-hold exports, HealthCo is focused on SOC2-ready evidence. Thoughts?
jason: TL;DR: we probably can't do both fully this sprint. Indexing to speed queries needs more storage/CPU. Options: sampling + on-demand reindex or precompute bundles.
marta: Security note: any reindex/export flow must never persist plaintext keys. BYOK/KMS handshake must be isolated; caches are ephemeral only.
sahil: Sales input — AcmeBank expects legal-hold export for up to ~100k events to finish <= 30s, that's the ask to hit contract.
anya: Proposed gating metrics: (1) evidence-export 95th <= 30s for 100k events; (2) search 99th <= 200ms for tenant-scoped queries; (3) BYOK handshake <5s during onboarding. Agree or too aggressive?
jason: Metrics make sense but 30s is aggressive without precompute. With prefix/KV caching and streaming exports we can get to ~45s in our bench. To hit 30s we'd need precomputed bundles (two-week window) which raises storage and precompute infra cost.
marta: Could we make precompute an "opt-in" paid feature? That avoids holding decrypted bundles for all tenants and limits blast radius.
legal-alex: Legal requirement: every legal-hold export needs an immutable snapshot id, signer (who requested), timestamp, and retention flags. That metadata must be stored in audit logs with TTLs controlled by contract.
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-4021 — evidence-export-performance benchmarks + infra cost estimate.
sahil: AcmeBank will accept 45s if we guarantee 0% missing events + full audit trail. HealthCo is firm on 30s due to internal SLAs. We'll need to negotiate per-customer.
jason: Suggest phased delivery: Phase A (MVP) = correctness + auditable export + BYOK handshake + export SLO 95th <= 60s. Low infra cost, focuses on reliability. Phase B = performance invest: precompute + dedicated index + reserved capacity to reach 30s.
anya: OK. Launch criteria for Phase A: (a) end-to-end tests for export correctness, (b) perf rails (95th <= 60s), (c) security/KMS sign-off, (d) docs + contract language for legal-hold. Owners: Jason (eng), Marta (security), legal-alex (legal), Sahil (sales). Target: ship in 2 sprints.
marta: Security checklist items: KMS integration matrix, HSM support decision doc, key rotation playbook, threat model update covering precompute opt-in.
jason: Action items list:
- ENG: micro-bench export pipeline, PR #612 (owner: jason)
- INFRA: cost estimate for precompute buckets and reserved index nodes (ticket INF-789)
- PRODUCT: pricing proposal for "precomputed evidence" addon and contract flags (ticket PRD-334)
I'll own ENG + INFRA tickets.
anya: I'll update roadmap. For Phase A set gating to 95th <= 60s; Phase B target = 30s. @sahil please reconfirm AcmeBank vs HealthCo deadlines and any legal hold contract clauses.
sahil: Will do. I'll update the customer-facing doc and loop Legal on contract flags.
jason: Example config snippet we'll use for toggles:
```
retention:
  legal_hold: true
  snapshot_window_days: 30
  precompute: false
```
Set precompute: true for reserved tenants who opt-in.
anya: Good. Let's reconvene after bench results. Eta: bench by end of week. :thumbsup:
marta: +1 security will review bench results and the HSM doc.
legal-alex: I'll draft the contract language for legal-hold exports and audit trail requirements.
anya: Thanks all — I'll post updated roadmap ticket when PROD-4021 has bench numbers.
